description: NaNdTiNbO₆F crystallizes in the orthorhombic Imma space group. Na is bonded to six O and two equivalent F atoms to form distorted NaO₆F₂ hexagonal bipyramids that share edges with two equivalent NaO₆F₂ hexagonal bipyramids, edges with four equivalent NdO₆F₂ hexagonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, and edges with four equivalent NbO₆ octahedra. There are two shorter (2.62 Å) and four longer (2.71 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Both Na-F bond lengths are 2.21 Å. Nd is bonded to six O and two equivalent F atoms to form distorted NdO₆F₂ hexagonal bipyramids that share edges with two equivalent NdO₆F₂ hexagonal bipyramids, edges with four equivalent NaO₆F₂ hexagonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent NbO₆ octahedra, and edges with four equivalent TiO₆ octahedra. There are four shorter (2.52 Å) and two longer (2.60 Å) Nd-O bond lengths. Both Nd-F bond lengths are 2.31 Å. Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent NbO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆F₂ hexagonal bipyramids, and edges with four equivalent NdO₆F₂ hexagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 45-48°. All Ti-O bond lengths are 1.98 Å. Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NbO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent TiO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent NdO₆F₂ hexagonal bipyramids, and edges with four equivalent NaO₆F₂ hexagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 40-45°. There are four shorter (2.01 Å) and two longer (2.02 Å) Nb-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Nd and two equivalent Ti atoms to form distorted ONd₂Ti₂ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent FNa₂Nd₂ tetrahedra, corners with four equivalent ONd₂Ti₂ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one FNa₂Nd₂ tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Nb atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Nd, one Ti, and one Nb atom. F is bonded to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Nd atoms to form FNa₂Nd₂ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONd₂Ti₂ tetrahedra, corners with four equivalent FNa₂Nd₂ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ONd₂Ti₂ tetrahedra.
